String.luau.description: String provides the module implementation used by the Stringutils package.

StringUtils.luau.description: This module provides utility functions for strings Public entry points include `StringUtils.trim`, `StringUtils.toCamelCase`, `StringUtils.uppercaseFirstLetter`, `StringUtils.toLowerCamelCase`, `StringUtils.toPrivateCase`, `StringUtils.trimFront`, `StringUtils.checkNumOfCharacterInStringUtils`, `StringUtils.isEmptyOrWhitespaceOrNil`.

UTF8Utils.luau.description: UTF8Utils utility functions Public entry points include `UTF8Utils.upper`, `UTF8Utils.lower`.
